Class Client

it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client.Client

      public void startAutoReconnect()
      Starts auto-reconnection in a dedicated thread: every 3 seconds attempts to establish a new connection (Socket or RMI, depending on the last used) and to rejoin the game with the same nickname, until successful. By updating the connection in the singleton, subsequent moves travel immediately on the new one.
